title: Minigame: E1.91 a Starshell opened by an enemy vehicle

source.basis: Manufactured under R0.3 as the second position of the E1.8 claim's minigame (the design's review, G2): the German force has no motorized vehicle on board, and a Russian motorized vehicle moves at night, its facts entered by hand.
source.legacy: None: a manufactured minigame (R0.3), adapting no legacy card
adaptation: A minimal card (ruling R22.3): a German squad and a Russian motorized vehicle, set up by hand; the night is a fact of each check.

introduction: A Russian vehicle moves in the dark: is it near enough for the German squad to send up the first Starshell?

victoryConditions.text: A minigame has no victory: it proves its rules on the Rule Workbench and in play.
